events.event_name: Cafe Yaeji: Oatly x Yaeji Gochujang Latte Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A two-day Korean dabang-inspired immersive cafe created by Oatly and artist/producer Yaeji.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary iced Gochujang Lattes made with espresso, Oatly Barista Edition, gochujang-vanilla base, salted vanilla cold foam and gochugaru.
events.caveats: No advance RSVP requirement was published in the sources reviewed; complimentary drinks are promotional and may be capacity/supply limited.
events.practical_notes: Saturday and Sunday, Sept. 19–20, 9 AM–3 PM at 48 Ludlow Street.

events.event_name: The Dewy Day Tour: Yepoda K-Beauty Pop-Up at Sephora Meatpacking
events.what_it_is: Yepoda's K-beauty Sephora launch pop-up with product trials, gifts and prize opportunities.
events.what_is_free: Attendance is free with no purchase necessary; exclusive free gifts are offered while supplies last and visitors can enter for Sephora gift cards and full-size products.
events.caveats: Free gifts are while supplies last. Purchase-based GWPs at $40+ or $60+ are separate from the no-purchase-required attendance/freebies.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, noon–6 PM, outside Sephora Meatpacking on 13th Street.

events.event_name: Max Mara Le Parfum NYC Pop-Up at Herald Square
events.what_it_is: An open-air Max Mara Le Parfum launch activation outside Macy's Herald Square with an interactive scent experience, games and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary gelato, fragrance samples and chances at promotional giveaways, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Promotional samples, gelato and giveaways are while supplies last. The Eventbrite listing is free and organizer-posted by Max Mara.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–6 PM at Macy's Herald Square Plaza.

events.what_it_is: A launch event for LONDONTOWN and Magnolia Bakery's dessert-inspired nail lacquer collaboration.
events.what_is_free: The first 100 guests receive a Banana Pudding and a Banana Pudding lakur. After that, the nail lacquer is offered free with purchase while supplies last.
events.caveats: The no-purchase free pudding + lakur is limited to the first 100 guests. Later promotional lakur requires purchase and is while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19 starting 11 AM; secondary event listing gives an 11 AM–1 PM activation window. First-come for the first-100 giveaway.

events.event_name: Shake Your Soul Pop-Up with Live Brazilian Samba
events.brand: Stuyvesant Park Neighborhood Association × Manhattan Street Samba Rio
events.address: Stuyvesant Square Park West, Rutherford Place, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A Hispanic Heritage Month movement pop-up combining Shake Your Soul instruction with live Brazilian samba music.
events.what_is_free: The two-hour movement and live-music program is free and open to all.
events.caveats: Organizer describes it as free and open to all and also provides an RSVP page; no selection/approval step is established.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20, 2–4 PM in Stuyvesant Square Park's West Park. No dance experience necessary.

events.event_name: YES! Block Party — Free All Day
events.what_it_is: House of Yes's 10th annual street block party with performances, live music, DJs, games, community resources, makers, vendors and an indoor afterparty.
events.what_is_free: The block party is advertised as free all day; programming includes free La Colombe coffee and an all-ages daytime program. The later indoor afterparty is also advertised free but is 21+.
events.caveats: The official page offers a Get Tickets action despite repeatedly advertising the event as free. Daytime block party is all ages; afterparty is 21+. Normal venue capacity rules apply.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20; doors/noon start. Rain or shine, indoors and outdoors at House of Yes and the surrounding street activation.
